verdict.rationale: Amplitude's docs describe charts, dashboards, and insights as a core feature, with a documented 'Create a dashboard' flow, and team spaces for organizing charts, dashboards, and notebooks for the owning team. A Dashboard REST API also exposes dashboard data, which supports the core of composing and sharing dashboards. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of adding saved charts to a dashboard, details on sharing and permission controls (links, viewer access), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard workflow.
